When equilibrium, weight force = total mass * g =30*10=300 N. This force is transmitted via piston area, generating pressure increase Δp = F / A = 300 / 0.003 = 100,000 Pa = 1.0e5 Pa. So pressure inside cylinder = p0 + Δp = 2.0e5 Pa.

Option A (Quá trình ghế hạ xuống, khí trong xi lanh thực hiện công dương.) When seat moves down, piston compresses gas, gas does work on piston? Actually gas is being compressed, piston does work on gas (negative work by gas). The gas volume decreases, so gas does negative work (work done by gas is negative). So statement "khí trong xi lanh thực hiện công dương" (gas does positive work) is false. So option A false.

Option B: "Khi ghế để trống, cột khí trong xi lanh dài 20 cm." Not given; we have no info about column length when empty. Not derivable; likely false.

Option D: "Khi học sinh ngồi trên ghế, áp suất khí trong xi lanh là 2.0×10^5 Pa." That's true as computed. So option D true.

Latent heat L = 4.0×10^5 J/kg. Q2 = m*L = 0.02*4.0e5 = 8,000 J.

Total useful energy Q = 11,176 + 8,000 = 19,176 J ≈ 1.92e4 J.

Efficiency η = Q / E_in = 19,176 / 34,000 = 0.564 (56.4%). So correct answer is first option "Hiệu suất là $56.4\\,\\%$."
